questions.question: Why is the LORD to be praised with a new song in Psalm 98?
options: Because he has made the whole earth, and the very heavens declare his glory
Because he has done marvelous things; his right hand has worked salvation
Because he has chosen Zion for himself, and his temple shall stand forever
Because he has given the holy law, and all of his commandments are righteous
questions.answer: Because he has done marvelous things; his right hand has worked salvation

questions.question: What are the sea, rivers, and hills told to do?
options: Fast, weep, and mourn before the LORD
Wait, watch, and listen before the LORD
Tremble, bow, and keep silent before the LORD
Roar, clap, and sing for joy before the LORD
questions.answer: Roar, clap, and sing for joy before the LORD

questions.question: The psalm says the LORD will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
Oh sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done _____!
Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth into joyous song and sing _____!
